'''Cednah Faenel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noblewoman who lived on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. She loved dancing, and spent a significant amount of money to restore the [[Grand Theater]] in the city of [[Belleau-a-Lir]]. She attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''.
